The weighted campus energy balance calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating robust handling of multi-source energy inputs.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across all trials with zero exceptions recorded in the adhoc hermes gpt-5.5 environment. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed the logic via test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite, which passed in 0.49 seconds. While the current implementation is stable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in the weighting coefficients to ensure they remain normalized under varying campus load profiles.
